Applies engineering principles to perform routine design, fabrication, modification, and evaluation in support of manufacturing operations.
Prepares plans, process specifications and procedures, designs equipment, production aids and assembly fixtures, supports MRP studies, and develops factory cost work standards.
Conducts analysis or tests related to the development of new methods, materials, processes, or standards and documents recommendations accordingly.
Analyzes engineering data and change notices to create manufacturing Bills of Materials and routings for various product lines.
Performs other related duties as required.
cond_0295.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM), or an Advanced Degree in a related field, or 6 years of relevant experience in the absence of a degree
Minimum 2 years of prior relevant experience (with a degree)
Must be authorized to work in [Location masked] without sponsorship now or in the future
Preferred Requirements
Prior engineering experience in a manufacturing or assembly environment
Prior experience with composites and/or fabrication
Process Improvement/Lean Manufacturing experience
